svg.text: Design notes · suggestion review
Review opens on its own when Ada's versions
are newer than the person's last edit or
last review (same rule as Docs: reviewBase).
Pending local edits are saved first, and the
toolbar and canvas are read-only until every
change is decided.
One decision per changed slide (added,
removed, moved, modified), plus one for a
theme change. Before and after use the real
slide renderer. Changed elements are
outlined: red dashed for before, green for
after. The text list is what screen readers
get.
Accept and Reject use the approval colours
(a person decides). A decided card collapses
to a single line with Undo until the review
is finished. Keyboard: J/K next and previous
change, A accept, R reject, ⇧A accept all.
Finishing saves one new version noted “Kept
2 of Ada's 3 changes, rejected 1” and marks
it reviewed, so Ada reads the outcome on her
next turn. Rejecting a removed slide puts it
back after its old neighbour.
Thumbnails carry an amber “Ada” badge on
changed slides. Clicking a thumbnail scrolls
to its change card.
